post.summary: N1 verification: send a test notification to the caller's OWN subscriptions.
Register (upsert on endpoint) a browser push subscription for the caller.

get.summary: The VAPID public key the browser needs to create a PushSubscription.
A team's APPROVED employees. ACCOUNTS_ADMIN: any team. ACCOUNTANT: only their OWN team (else 404).
A team's roll-up + live today snapshot for a shift-month (default = current) or a custom from/to range (own-team-only for the Accountant and the Manager).
The ACCOUNTANT's own team (roster header); null if none assigned.
One employee's live attendance metrics for a shift-month (default = current) or a custom from/to range.
An employee's per-month metric series (last N shift-months; default 6).
Companies to drill into (ACCOUNTS_ADMIN only; the Accountant has one team).
A company's teams with HR/Manager + approved-employee counts (ACCOUNTS_ADMIN).

delete.summary: Remove the caller's own push subscription (by endpoint).

targeted.description: How many of the caller's subscriptions were targeted.

message.description: Human-readable status (e.g. push disabled, or sent).

TestResult.description: Result of a test send to the caller's own subscriptions.

endpoint.description: Push service endpoint URL (unique per browser/device).

userAgent.description: Optional user-agent label for the device.

SubscribeRequest.description: A browser PushSubscription to register for the acting principal.

id.description: Server id of the stored subscription.

existing.description: True if this endpoint was already registered and was updated.

password.description: Echoed once in dev; null in prod

openSince.description: Clock-in time of the open session (ISO UTC); null when not clocked in

breakOpenSince.description: Start time of the open break (ISO UTC); null when not on a break

isLateToday.description: Whether the first clock-in of the current shift-day was late (after 19:20 IST)

todaySeconds.description: Worked seconds today (this shift-day), completed sessions minus breaks

weekSeconds.description: Worked seconds this week, completed sessions minus breaks

publicKey.description: VAPID public key (base64url); empty when push is not configured.

enabled.description: Whether the server has Web Push configured (VAPID keys present).

PublicKeyResponse.description: The VAPID public key the browser needs to create a PushSubscription.

MyTeamView.description: The ACCOUNTANT's own team — the roster header (null if none assigned).

TrendPoint.description: One month of the trends series (YYYY-MM, IST). offboarded is a 0 placeholder.

CompanyTotals.description: Companies on the platform: total, active and archived (status = DELETED).

OnboardingFunnel.description: The current onboarding funnel — how many employees sit at each status right now.

totalOnboarded.description: Every onboarded employee record (a record exists only once onboarded).

averageTimeToApprovalDays.description: Mean days between Employee.createdAt and ApprovalRequest.decidedAt over approved employees; null when none approved.

stuckThresholdDays.description: The stuck-onboarding age threshold, in days (configurable constant).

stuckOnboardings.description: Pre-approval employees older than the threshold (by Employee.createdAt).

stuckByStage.description: The stuck count broken down by the stage they're stuck at.

OpsMetrics.description: Operational metrics over the whole platform (all-time unless noted).

PlatformOverview.description: The one-call platform overview: totals + funnel + ops metrics.

PlatformTotals.description: Platform totals: companies, teams, employees and staff-by-role counts.

StaffTotals.description: Currently-assigned staff counts by role (a count, never a people list).

StuckStage.description: Employees stuck at a given pre-approval stage past the threshold.

CompanySizeRow.description: One company's size row: name, archived flag, team + employee counts.

CompanyBreakdown.description: One company's org structure: counts + by-status + the assigned Company Admin + its teams' assigned staff. Names STAFF only — no employee identity/PII.

StaffRef.description: An assigned staff member (name + email); null when the slot is unassigned.

TeamBreakdown.description: One team's org row — its assigned HR/Manager/Accountant + employee count.

date.description: shift-day yyyy-MM-dd in Asia/Kolkata (the day the shift started)

workedSeconds.description: Worked seconds = duration minus breaks; null while the session is open

unapprovedAbsences.description: Past working days with no session and no approved leave, this month.

TeamAttendanceMemberRow.description: One row of a team's attendance roster for the month.

month.description: The shift-month, YYYY-MM; null for a custom from/to range — use periodStart/periodEnd.

periodStart.description: First day of the reported window, YYYY-MM-DD (IST).

periodEnd.description: Last day of the reported window, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (IST).

presentToday.description: Employees with at least one session on today's shift-day.

clockedInNow.description: Employees with an OPEN session right now.

onLeaveToday.description: Employees on an approved leave that covers today (IST calendar date).

totalLateThisMonth.description: Sum of the team's late logins this month.

TeamAttendanceSummary.description: A team's attendance roll-up for a month OR custom range + a live 'today' snapshot.

month.description: The shift-month, YYYY-MM (Asia/Kolkata); null for a custom from/to range — use periodStart/periodEnd for the authoritative window.

periodStart.description: First day of the reported window, YYYY-MM-DD (IST).

periodEnd.description: Last day of the reported window, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (IST).

workedSeconds.description: Worked seconds = completed sessions' duration MINUS their breaks (open = 0).

breakSeconds.description: Break seconds = completed breaks in the month.

daysPresent.description: Distinct shift-days with at least one session.

leaveDaysTotal.description: Total approved leave days in the month (sum of leavesByType).

leaveRequests.description: Number of approved leave REQUESTS overlapping the month.

workingDays.description: Working days in the month per the stated rule (Mon–Fri).

expectedDays.description: Adherence denominator = working days − approved leave on working days.

unapprovedAbsences.description: Past working days (before today, IST) with no session and no approved leave. Today/future never count.

adherencePct.description: present-on-working ÷ expectedDays as a whole percent; null when expectedDays = 0 (N/A).

workingDaysDefinition.description: Human label of how workingDays / adherence / absence are defined.

clockedInNow.description: Whether the employee has an OPEN session right now (live).

EmployeeMonthSummary.description: One employee's attendance metrics for a shift-month OR custom range (computed live).

LeavesByType.description: Approved leave DAYS in the month, split by type (calendar days, clipped to the month).

idleSeconds.description: Optional idle seconds; null in v1 (worked + break are the real, summable split).

TimeComposition.description: The same-unit split for a donut. worked + break = gross clocked time; idle is not computed in v1.

EmployeeMonthlySeries.description: A per-month series of the employee's metrics (oldest → newest).

teamCount.description: Number of teams in the company.

employeeCount.description: Number of APPROVED employees in the company.

ViewerCompanyRow.description: One company at the top of the ACCOUNTS_ADMIN drilldown.

hrName.description: The team HR's name (null if unassigned).

managerName.description: The team Manager's name (null if unassigned).

employeeCount.description: Number of APPROVED employees on this team.

ViewerTeamRow.description: One team within a company — its HR, Manager and approved-employee count.

UnsubscribeRequest.description: Remove a previously registered subscription (by endpoint).
